text_block_list.text:
The time for summer training camp arrived 
once again this year, but—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You oughta know... After all, you 
experienced it last year too.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And yet—damn it!! I can't stop it, no 
matter what!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I CAN'T STOP GETTING HYPED UP FOR THIS 
OVERNIGHT TRIP ALREADY, DAMMIIIIT!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Shut up!! How am I supposed to calm down?! 
I'm an Umamusume going through puberty 
here!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
My heart won't stop pounding, and it's 
getting hard to... breathe... Gwah?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
N-No way, *cough*...!! Breathe, at least 
breathe, meeeeee!!

And by the time we reached the training 
camp lodging...

Because I horsed around way too much on 
the bus, I'm predictably exhausted again 
this year...!

There's a bit of anxiety, but— let's do 
our best at this year's training camp 
regardless!
